system.description:
You can make shots that others find difficult. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Bullseye Weapons. You gain the following benefits;

Your weapons long range increment becomes its base range. Attacks within this range increment are not made at disadvantage.

The first ranged weapon attack you make each turn using a Bullseye Weapon against a creature that is unaware of you or you are Hidden from gains a +1 bonus to its critical threat range, and Pierce 4.

When you are targeted with a ranged attack that you can see, you may as a reaction, make a ranged weapon attack vs the triggering creatures ranged attack result. If your result is higher than theirs, you divert their attack by selecting a different creature within 30 feet of them, making that creature the new target of the triggering creatures attack.

Beginning at 5th level, when you make a weapon attack or a ranged Taijutsu attack using a Bullseye Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Pinpoint shot.

Pinpoint Shot. Make a weapon attack against a creature. On a hit, deal your [Weapon Damage]. If the target is unaware of you, you are hidden from them, or they are at your furthest possible range to target them, maximize its weapon damage die.

Beginning at 10th level, when you divert an attack using this stance, you can make one additional ranged weapon attack targeting the new target of the triggering creatures attack. When you hit with a Pinpoint Shot against a creature that is unaware of you, they must make a Constitution saving throw against your Taijutsu Save DC or become Bruised.
system.requirement: Ranged, Ammunition or Thrown Weapon Group
